method.description: Read-only research and promotion-readiness audit. No code, configuration, feature flag or value was changed. This inventory and its report are the only new files.
evidenceChannels: git (origin/main and branches, git show / git grep / git log)
gh (pull requests, issues, workflow runs, Dependabot alerts, rulesets, secret names only)
public curl of chaseupside.com (/api/status, /api/health, public league routes)
read-only ssh to the production box (systemctl show, journalctl, file and SQLite reads in read-only mode)
local files and worktrees on the owner machine (read-only)
notUsed: any write, restart, dispatch or deploy
the excluded Chase Upside MCP work (PR #1921)

assembly.inputs: Seven category catalogs (alreadyAssessed lists hold 19 earlier assessments: SRC-001/005/007/008 and VAL-001..008, 011..017), four category assessment files (68 items), two collector files (38 items), and a list of 11 items merged away during de-duplication.
assembly.verification: 87 initiatives + 38 collectors = 125 distinct ids; 0 missing, 0 duplicated, 0 NOT_ASSESSED. Collector ids are COL-nnn in the catalog and RPA-COL-nnn in the assessments (the same 38).
assembly.itemsUnchanged: items[] holds every assessment exactly as written by its assessor. Some item text pre-dates the 2026-10-26 status updates; the report lists the corrections, the items are not edited.
assembly.findingsDerivation: findings[] restates defects named in the items plus the auditor's checks against git/gh on 2026-10-26. No new initiative was created.

operationalStatus.LIVE: Running in production; nothing pending beyond observation.
operationalStatus.COLLECTING_ACTIVE: A collector or monitor is running and producing output.
operationalStatus.COLLECTING_STALE: Running, but its inputs or output are older than their budget.
operationalStatus.COLLECTING_BROKEN: Running or scheduled, but not producing usable output.
operationalStatus.SHADOW_RUNNING: A shadow challenger is running and recording.
operationalStatus.SHADOW_NOT_RUNNING: Shadow code is merged or authorized but nothing is producing shadow evidence.
operationalStatus.DORMANT_IMPLEMENTED: Merged and tested but switched off, unwired or held.
operationalStatus.NOT_STARTED: Authorized or wanted, but nobody has started.
operationalStatus.WAITING_ON_OWNER: Needs an owner decision or owner-only action.
operationalStatus.WAITING_ON_DEPENDENCY: Needs another item, vendor or date first.

evidenceStatus.NEEDS_MORE_DATA: A sample size or date must pass before a decision.
evidenceStatus.NEEDS_PREREGISTRATION: No frozen evaluation criteria exist yet.
evidenceStatus.NEEDS_METHODOLOGY_REVISION: The current design cannot yield a valid answer.
evidenceStatus.OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Evidence is not the blocker; an owner decision is.
evidenceStatus.NOT_A_PROMOTION_CANDIDATE: Infrastructure, collector or record with nothing to promote.
evidenceStatus.ENGINEERING_NOT_READY: A defect or missing build blocks any evaluation.
evidenceStatus.BLOCKED: Cannot proceed on a named external or governance block.
evidenceStatus.READY_FOR_DECISION: Enough evidence exists for the decision that is on the table.
evidenceStatus.EVIDENCE_SUPPORTS_REJECTION: The evidence favours rejecting or retiring.
evidenceStatus.EVIDENCE_SUPPORTS_ADVANCEMENT: The evidence favours advancing the work.

verificationPrefixes.VERIFIED: Read or measured directly in git, gh, a public endpoint, or a read-only box session.
verificationPrefixes.INFERRED: Concluded from verified facts but not observed directly.
verificationPrefixes.UNVERIFIED: Could not be checked with the allowed access.
verificationPrefixes.CORRECTED: An input claim was wrong and the item states the corrected fact.
verificationPrefixes.CONTRADICTED: The evidence contradicts an input claim or a record.

enums.priority: The assessors' own label: P0 (one item) is the most urgent, then P1, P2, P3. No separate definition was supplied.

stageScale0to6.0: Idea or request only; no evidence work.
stageScale0to6.1: Research or evidence gathered (verified and authorized).
stageScale0to6.2: A candidate implementation is justified and authorized.
stageScale0to6.3: Shadow evaluation is ready or running.
stageScale0to6.4: Merged dormant: tested, disabled or held, with locks.
stageScale0to6.5: Activated (live) under authorization, with validation as far as it exists.
stageScale0to6.6: Verified in production: observed on the deployed surface.
stageScale0to6.note: highestVerifiedAuthorizedStage is the highest stage that is both verified and authorized. This scale is reconstructed from the assessors' stageNotes; collectors that are running and observed in production carry stage 6.

groupMeanings.1: Owner decisions possible now: the evidence is enough for a specific decision the owner can make today.
groupMeanings.2: Active engineering: authorized, dependency-ready work that needs engineers, not an owner decision.
groupMeanings.3: Collecting: running and waiting on a sample size or a date.
groupMeanings.4: Blocked: waiting on a dependency, a vendor, an owner-held credential or a defect fix; includes broken collectors whose fix is in an unmerged PR.
groupMeanings.5: Retire or superseded: the remaining work is closing, deleting or correcting records.

findingStatusRule.CONFIRMED: At least one VERIFIED line in the source item reproduces the defect itself (read code, ran a parser, parsed a log or payload, measured a live value). Where the number comes from a draft PR that was not re-run, the finding says so.
findingStatusRule.SUSPECTED: The defect or its impact rests on INFERRED lines.
findingStatusRule.UNRESOLVED: The headline claim is UNVERIFIED with the allowed access.

severityRubric.critical: A confirmed defect that is serving a wrong value or exposing something in production now, with no compensating control. No finding meets this bar.
severityRubric.high: A confirmed or unresolved defect that silently corrupts, hides or loses evidence or exposes security or money paths, or leaves a monitor reporting success over a failure, where a compensating control limits the blast radius.
severityRubric.medium: Degraded evidence, misleading status, or a gap in a gate or monitor without a current wrong served value.

limits: The assessors' box and production reads were taken between 2026-10-25 and 2026-10-26 and are not repeated here.
This audit did not re-run test suites, replays or draft-PR evidence; where a figure comes from a draft PR the finding says so.
Authenticated endpoints (for example /api/sources/weighting and /api/data) were not read, so per-source weights and served confidence labels are unmeasured.
Group, priority, severity and stage are judgments recorded as assessed; this report does not re-grade them.

items.name: Scheduled data refresh workflow and in-process box scrape loop
items.objective: Keep every external ranking/value source current in main and in the served board: the GH Actions scheduled-refresh (HTTP and Playwright fetchers, rebuild, freshness stamps, deploy) plus the dynasty.service in-process KTC/IDP Trade Calculator scrape every 2h.
items.currentImplementation: .github/workflows/scheduled-refresh.yml, cron '42 */2' (12 runs/day declared). Pinned to ubuntu-24.04 by #1939 (merged 2026-10-26 11:33Z); the other Playwright workflows (draftsharks-diagnostic, e2e, prod-e2e-smoke, v1-authenticated-verification) are still runs-on ubuntu-latest. Failure design: a fetcher that fails restores its last-good CSV and does NOT stamp <key>_last_success (stamp_if_present), so staleness stays visible in the stamps; the only loud signal is a ::warning annotation. Only DLF has a hard freshness guard (exit 1 past a threshold). The KTC 'too small' check passes on the restored last-good file, so nothing fails for KTC/IDPTC/DraftSharks. After #1939 a failed 'playwright install chromium' emits a ::warning but stays non-fatal. Second producer: dynasty.service runs its own in-process scrape every 2h with its own Chromium (KTC 500 players, IDPTC 1027 capped to 900), writes the CSVs into the deploy checkout (git status on the box shows ktc*.csv modified) and rebuilds the served board; it does not write data/scrape_state/*_last_success.
items.evidenceCollected: (1) gh run list: 32 scheduled runs in the last 7 days (about 4.6/day against 12/day declared, 38%), 32 of 32 concluded success. Latest 2026-10-26T08:07:07Z. The post-pin run (due about 12:42Z) had not started at 12:12Z. (2) The 08:07Z run log says 'Image: ubuntu-26.04', 'Error: ERROR: Playwright does not support chromium on ubuntu26.04-x64' (hidden by '2>/dev/null || true'), then 'BrowserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist' at pw.chromium.launch; the run still concluded success. Four runs fall after the label moved (10-25 16:49Z and 21:14Z, 10-26 00:43Z and 08:07Z); only the 08:07Z log was read directly, the others follow #1939's account. (3) Stamps: ktc, ktcSfTep, idpTradeCalc _last_success = 2026-10-25T12:03:37Z; draftSharks 12:06:15Z. /api/status source_health.sources shows ktc, idpTradeCalc 24.02 h and draftSharks 23.98 h old at 12:05Z, while /api/health reports data_stale false, data_age_hours 0.4, source_health_ok true. The dataset-state content clock agrees with the stamps: ktcCrowdSfTep players lastChange 2026-10-25T12:07:00Z. (4) The box loop itself is healthy: 09:36Z and 11:36Z scrapes succeeded (226-262 s, 1095 players, 2/2 sites, last_success_at 11:40:28Z, next 13:40Z); the 'KTC completed (4 mapped values)' line is the autocomplete top-up count, not the board size (box log: KTC 500, IDPTradeCalc 1027). The box CSVs were rewritten 12:39 CET, so served KTC/IDPTC values are live while /api/status shows their stamps as 24 h old. (5) Fetch time vs content: fantasyNavigatorSf fetched 08:08Z today but content last changed 2026-10-10, and idpShowCombined fetched every 2h with vendor lastModifiedAt 2026-08-19; both are correctly withheld from voting (contract warnings source_votes_withheld:fantasyNavigatorSf:443 and idpShowCombined:655, status degraded). (6) Anomaly: draftSharks dataset lastChange is 2026-10-25T16:50:28Z (11 rows changed; draftSharksSf.csv and draftSharksRosSf.csv were rewritten in commit ed59d0dc6) although its last_success stamp stayed 12:06:15Z; the two clocks disagree and the cause is not established. (7) Related refit workflow dispatches fire after every refresh including degraded ones.
items.evaluationCriteria: Pre-existing: DLF freshness guard in scheduled-refresh.yml (exit 1 past THRESHOLD_HOURS); 6 h staleness convention (SCRAPE_INTERVAL_HOURS*3); contract health lanes (structuralErrors vs sourceHealthErrors); cadence-relative freshness curve config/sources/freshness_v1.json. No criterion exists for 'a browser fetcher produced a fresh CSV this run'.
items.existingResults: Collector runs and reports success; since 2026-10-25 16:49Z four runs produced no KTC/IDPTC/DraftSharks refresh behind green status. Stamps stayed honest (not advanced), but no check failed and /api/health stayed 'ok'.
items.branchesPRs: #1939 merged 2026-10-26 (runner pin, loud-but-non-fatal install, IDP staleness report docs/ops/IDP_SOURCE_STALENESS_2026-10-25.md); commit 34bc0deea (last good stamps). draftsharks-diagnostic.yml unpinned.

items.missingEvidence: Result of the first post-pin run (ktc/idptc/draftSharks stamps must advance past 2026-10-25T12:03Z); why draftSharks content changed on a run whose fetch stamp did not advance; whether 26.04 breaks any other Playwright workflow; why only 32 of 84 expected runs fired (GitHub cron drift vs skipped slots).
items.qA_enoughToDecide: YES for the diagnosis (runner image, hidden install error, green-on-nothing); NO for 'repaired', which needs the post-pin run.
items.qB_evidenceFavors: REVISE (add a fail-loud freshness guard for the browser sources; keep the pin)

A hard guard for KTC/IDPTC/DraftSharks is a workflow change that needs a work claim; no owner decision found for it (UNVERIFIED: EXECUTION_PLAN not re-read in this batch).
items.decisionPossibleNow: No owner decision. Verify the post-pin run, then decide whether to add a fail-loud guard.
items.nextAction: Confirm the 12:42Z-window run on ubuntu-24.04 advances ktc/ktcSfTep/idpTradeCalc/draftSharks stamps. Then add a content-level guard (fail or open an issue when a browser source is not rewritten for N consecutive runs). Pin draftsharks-diagnostic.yml and review the other ubuntu-latest Playwright workflows. Move to group 3 once the stamps advance.

items.name: Hill refit challenger loop and autopilot run ledger
items.objective: Refit the percentile-form Hill masters after every material data refresh, score the challenger against boards the fit never reads, record the verdict, and promote automatically only through the fail-closed Hill Autopilot path.
items.currentImplementation: refit-hill-curves.yml is dispatched (workflow_dispatch) after each scheduled refresh; scripts/auto_refit_hill_curves.py and scripts/hill_autopilot.py append config/model_registry/hill_autopilot_runs.jsonl and commit 'record Hill two-hour refit evidence' to main. Fit sources are FantasyCalc, OTCFFB and PFKDynasty (rows 396/400/400). Champion version 2; winner version 246; safe promotion scope OFFENSE only.
items.evidenceCollected: (1) gh run list: 32 runs in 7 days, 28 success, 4 failure (2026-10-20 00:02Z, 10-21 01:05Z, 10-21 14:14Z, 10-24 16:22Z); all four fail with '##[error]main advanced during evaluation; refusing stale write', i.e. a race with the other bots pushing to main. (2) hill_autopilot_runs.jsonl has 190 lines; the 08:15:34Z 10-26 run is outcome AUTO_PROMOTION_BLOCKED, reason no_independent_validation_target, with cross_market_bootstrap, current_margin, forward_persistence (true since the 10-26 00:48Z run) and leave_one_market_out passing and independent_validation false; forwardWinRate 1.0, forwardMedianImprovement 622.5 against requiredImprovement 56.6; candidate criterion about 511 vs champion 1132. (3) The run triggered at 08:15Z used triggerSha f1dc2b0c (the refresh produced while KTC/IDPTC/DraftSharks were restored last-good), so recent refits train on boards whose three browser sources are 20+ hours old; the fit sources themselves (FantasyCalc, OTCFFB, PFKDynasty) are HTTP and were fresh. (4) excludedFromTournament shows legacySubstrateCount 101 and many 'stale_code_or_manifest' exclusions.
items.evaluationCriteria: Pre-existing: Hill Autopilot v2 gates (docs/valuation/HILL_AUTOPILOT_V2.md): current_margin, forward_persistence, leave_one_market_out, cross_market_bootstrap, parameter_stability, board-impact caps, and gate 7 independent validation (eligible preregistered target required).
items.existingResults: Challenger passes every gate except gate 7; gate 7 can never pass because src/model_registry/independent_validation.py has no eligible target.
items.branchesPRs: No open PR found for gate 7. Evidence commits by github-actions[bot] (for example c65f021df).
items.blockers: Gate 7: no eligible preregistered independent validation target (owner decision 1, 2026-10-01). 4 of 32 runs lose their evidence to the main-advanced race.
items.missingEvidence: A preregistered independent validation target; whether the 4 refused runs left gaps in forward_persistence evidence; sensitivity of the verdict to the stale browser-source inputs.
items.qA_enoughToDecide: NO: all internal gates pass but promotion is structurally blocked until an independent validation target is preregistered.
items.qB_evidenceFavors: CONTINUE_COLLECTING (internal evidence favors the challenger; it cannot be acted on)
items.qC_authorized: CLAUDE.md 'Hill Autopilot canonical rule' and docs/valuation/HILL_AUTOPILOT_V2.md; owner decision 1 (2026-10-01) makes gate 7 mandatory. Promotion beyond OFFENSE scope is not authorized.
items.decisionPossibleNow: Owner/methodology: define an eligible independent validation target, or accept that the loop produces evidence only.
items.nextAction: Preregister an independent validation target (or decide none will exist). Retry-on-race for the refit commit so 4 of 32 runs are not lost. Do not hand-edit Hill constants.

items.name: Sharp transaction crawl, and Sharp/own-league format-at-trade-time capture
items.objective: Crawl transactions of sharp-eligible Sleeper leagues for the completed-trade ledger, and capture each league's format with dated, hashed rows so a trade is graded under its own season's rules.
items.currentImplementation: Box timer dynasty-sharp-transactions (about every 6 h): scripts/crawl_sharp_transactions.py crawls league rosters and transactions through the shared sleeper_api circuit breaker, then a budgeted Sharp format catch-up pass and the own-league previous_league_id chain pass (src/trade/own_league_format_capture.py).
items.evidenceCollected: (1) 28 runs in the last 7 days; the last run exited 2 and systemd records Result=success. Per-run summaries (leaguesConsidered 6,090-6,092): leaguesFetched = 0 in 13 of 28 runs and at most 5 in three more; 50-60 per run from 2026-10-23 16:26 to 10-26 03:23; 0 again on 2026-10-26 09:25 CET. leaguesFailed is a constant 598 in the zero runs and leaguesPending about 5,494. (2) Mechanism visible in the journal: the first five queued leagues return 'HTTP Error 404: Not Found' on /rosters, which opens the shared sleeper_api breaker (threshold 5 in 60 s), and every remaining league is fast-failed with 'breaker OPEN, fast-fail'. The same roughly 598 dead leagues sit at the head of the queue every run. (3) So the Sleeper lane of the completed-trade ledger rests on 10,309 trades from roughly 50-60 leagues per run when the pass works and from none when it does not. (4) Own-league format store: own_league_format_captures.sqlite 147 KB (7 season-chain rows, 9 captures, 192 observations) updated 09:29 CET; Sharp format store in the intel ledger holds 9,962 captures, 11,851 checks, 11,346 observations. (5) The sibling record and roster passes are budget-capped rather than breaker-capped (see COL-016). (6) The unit exits 2 and systemd records Result=success, so nothing alerts.
items.evaluationCriteria: NONE_DEFINED (no minimum coverage or fetched-fraction criterion exists for a run).
items.existingResults: Coverage is a small fraction of the eligible population; the ledger's Sleeper lane is correspondingly thin and biased toward leagues that happen to succeed.
items.branchesPRs: Not examined; docs/market_trades/TARGET_FORMAT_CENSUS.md describes consumers. PR #1926 did not touch this unit.
items.blockers: 404 leagues are treated as breaker failures; they are never removed from the queue. Nothing records the fetched fraction.
items.missingEvidence: Whether the 404 leagues are deleted/renamed leagues that should be dropped from eligibility; why the fetched count rose to 50-60 on 10-23 and fell to zero on 10-26 09:25; effect on ledger recency (Sleeper lane newest date 2026-10-25).
items.qA_enoughToDecide: NO: coverage of the lane is not established.
items.qB_evidenceFavors: REVISE (404 must not trip the breaker; dead leagues leave the queue; fetched fraction reported)
items.qC_authorized: Standing box timer; evidence only. Fix is an ordinary bounded defect repair.
items.decisionPossibleNow: No.
items.nextAction: Classify HTTP 404 as a terminal league state (mark dead, skip, no breaker count); report leaguesFetched / leaguesConsidered and exit non-zero when it is under a floor; re-measure.
verification: VERIFIED: per-run counts parsed from 28 journal runs; breaker and 404 lines read from the 09:25 CET run.

items.name: ESPN injury feed refresh
items.objective: Poll ESPN's injury feed every 4h, diff against the prior snapshot, and turn injury and activation transitions into BDVM events.
items.currentImplementation: Box timer dynasty-injury-feed-refresh (about every 4 h) with unit-local RISKIT_FEATURE_ESPN_INJURY_FEED=1: scripts/refresh_injury_feed.py fetches the feed, treats a proven fetch with zero parsed entries as 'no active injuries', diffs against data/nfl_data/injuries_prior.json and merges events into data/bdvm/events/2026.json. A separate injury_return_evidence path writes data/nfl_data/injury_return_evidence.json.
items.evidenceCollected: (1) Result=success every run; last 2026-10-26 09:10 CET. All 42 runs in the last 7 days logged 'no active injuries returned (fetch proven)' and 'no transitions this run'; 180 such lines over 40 days. (2) injuries_prior.json is 2 bytes ('[]'), overwritten every run. (3) The evidence path works: 'injury return evidence: rosterAthletes 2557, outType 513, unresolved 3, athleteFetches 27, athleteFetchFailures 0, players 510' (injury_return_evidence.json, 231 KB). So the same ESPN data yields 513 OUT athletes on one path and zero on the other. (4) Root cause per the audit context: the feed parser read 0 of 800 rows because athlete.id was missing from the payload (the parser reads athlete.id at src/nfl_data/injury_feed.py:251); the script then accepts 'zero entries from a proven fetch' as 'rare, but real' (comment at refresh_injury_feed.py line about 234). (5) data/bdvm/events/2026.json holds 244 events, all news:cbs; no injury-derived event has ever been written. (6) Draft PR #1952 (head 1157499b) parses the current payload and diverts derived events to a shadow file; seeds the prior silently.

items.name: Game Day live collector and Sleeper weekly projection archive (AL-P8 / G1)
items.objective: Record Game Day inputs as known at each tick (Sleeper live stats, weekly projections, league week state, ESPN scoreboard) plus a per-league generations index, and preserve the Sleeper weekly projection held before each player's kickoff before the 4-week raw-log prune deletes it (owner authorization 2026-09-29, #1519 G1). Supports RPA-LGI-004 and RPA-LGI-015.
items.currentImplementation: Box systemd timer dynasty-game-day-live fires every minute (oneshot, SuccessExitStatus=2, so 'nothing to do' stays green, exit 1 would fail the unit). scripts/run_game_day_live.py -> src/ros/game_day_live.py::run_tick: a cadence state machine (idle = hourly, live/near-kickoff = about a minute), append-only keyed-delta observation logs under data/game_day/live/_nfl and per-league generation.json + generations.jsonl + state.json; a new generation is written only when the input fingerprint (timestamps stripped) changes, otherwise outcome=inputs_unchanged. RAW_RETENTION_WEEKS=4: prune_retention() deletes an old NFL week's observations/ only after ensure_pregame_archive() has written and read back pregame_projections.json.gz (fail closed: on any failure the raw log is kept, a warning is logged and pregame_projections.retained.json is written). With the current week 7 the prune cut is week 3 (old = w < week - 4), so weeks 1-2 are already past it and week 3 first qualifies once the current week is 8 (3 < 4), so the first archive build is expected when Sleeper flips to week 8 (about 2026-10-27/29).

Output: data/game_day/predictions/2026/<league>/week_<n>/<roster>_pregame.json, one file per roster. items.name: Injury/availability: injury feed reports zero active injuries (suspected silent-empty) and the availability backtest

The availability model (src/ros/availability.py) reads Sleeper injury_status plus the separate per-athlete injury_return_evidence.json (510 players, healthy), not this feed.
items.evidenceCollected: ROOT CAUSE FOUND. The public ESPN injuries endpoint (fetched 2026-10-26T09:09Z) returns 800 entries across 32 teams (Out 178, Injured Reserve 50, Questionable 44, Doubtful 2, Suspension 1, Active 525). 800 of 800 entries lack athlete.id (the id now sits only in athlete links) and the team block lacks team.abbreviation. _parse_espn_payload skips any entry with an empty athlete id, so the production parser at origin/main returns 0 entries from this live payload while payload_shape_error returns None, which is exactly 'fetch proven' with zero entries. Box: 179 'no active injuries returned' log lines since 2026-09-01; the first 'fetch proven' line is 2026-10-08 and the first (2026-10-08) and latest (2026-10-26) injury_history snapshots both have entryCount 0 and the same content hash. items.objective: Make the 4-hourly Production E2E Smoke (public /league), Public League Warmup and Scheduled Health Check trustworthy: one live failure should be one actionable incident, and /api/public/league should not take longer than the monitor's own 60 s curl cap on a cold cache.
items.currentImplementation: No claim or PR exists. Monitors: .github/workflows/prod-e2e-smoke.yml (cron '17 */4 * * *', preflight curl --max-time 60 --compressed on /api/public/league), public-league-warmup.yml (cron '*/20 * * * *'), health-check.yml. Server cache: _PUBLIC_LEAGUE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS=300 (server.py). Repo variable PROD_PUBLIC_URL IS set (https://chaseupside.com, 2026-07-26).
items.evidenceCollected: gh run list: Smoke 19 failures / 23 successes over the last 42 runs (2026-10-04..10-26); 12 of the 20 runs 10-22..10-25 failed; last two runs (10-25 22:32Z, 10-26 04:45Z) succeeded. Failure mode in runs 40224120704 / 40162685579: 'curl: (28) Operation timed out after 60002 milliseconds with 0 bytes received' -> '::error Prod unreachable ... returned HTTP 000'. Warmup: 12 failures / 100 runs; 6 of 6 failed on 10-23, 7 of 7 succeeded 10-24 and 10-25. Health check: 4 of 4 failed on 10-23 only, 4 of 4 succeeded since 10-24. Actual cadence: warmup median gap 251 min (max 589) against a 20-minute cron; smoke median gap 379 min against 4 h. Live probes 2026-10-26 ~11:40Z: /api/health 0.37 s, /api/status 0.66 s, /api/public/league (no leagueKey) 44.1 s for 2.65 MB, then ?leagueKey=dynasty_main 1.15 s (cached).
items.evaluationCriteria: Pre-existing: preflight pass = HTTP 200 within 60 s; warmup budget 45 s curl / 3 min job; docs/GLOBAL_PERFORMANCE_STANDARD.md for latency budgets (not re-read in this batch). NONE_DEFINED for a failure-rate threshold.

After that, warmup and health are green but smoke still failed 5 of 8 runs on 10-24/10-25 - a different cause from the 10-23 incident.

items.name: FantasyPros IDP upstream clock (D5) remainder: dual-family duplicate-identity analysis
items.objective: Close owner directive D5 (2026-10-18, kept 2026-10-19): FantasyPros IDP freshness runs on the vendor's own expert-update clock (EXPLICIT_UPSTREAM_TIMESTAMP, never our fetch time; stale is reported, never zero), and the dual-family duplicate-identity analysis is completed so that no duplicated identity amplifies a vote and no legitimately independent material is suppressed.
items.currentImplementation: Clock half is live. Flag fantasypros_idp_upstream_clock defaults ON (src/api/feature_flags.py:273) and production /api/status (build f1dc2b0c, 2026-10-26) reports it enabled with gateStatus LIVE. config/sources/freshness_v1.json gives fantasyProsIdp the style EXPLICIT_UPSTREAM_TIMESTAMP (clock = the earlier of the vendor expert-update time and the last broad change). data/scrape_state/fantasyProsIdp_upstream.json on main: publishedAt 2026-09-04T02:34:24Z, expertsIncluded 6 of 6, label '9/04'. Duplicate half: scripts/fetch_fantasypros_idp.py still writes dual-eligible edge rushers twice (DL page and LB page; the second occurrence is keyed 'name#2' in dataset_integrity). The contract ranks this source over board rows (one per player), so each duplicated identity casts one vote at its better effective rank. The fetcher dedupe is deliberately deferred and pinned by strict-xfail tests (tests/scripts/test_fetch_fantasypros_idp.py, _PENDING_DEDUPE). The lineage defect 'fantasypros-idp-dual-family-duplicates' in config/sources/source_lineage.json still reads status 'open' although its own summary says ANALYSIS COMPLETED 2026-10-18.
items.evidenceCollected: (1) docs/sources/IDP_SOURCE_INDEPENDENCE_CLOSEOUT_2026-10-18.md, section 'Dual-family duplicate identities: analysis completed' (shipped by PR #1817, merged 2026-10-20): 15 dual-eligible edge rushers listed twice; on the pinned board 249 votes come from 249 distinct names; no vote amplification and no independent material suppressed; the duplicates' only remaining effect was on the broad-change clock, which no longer decides voting freshness; the fetcher dedupe stays deferred because dropping the name#2 rows would still add one false closed interval to cadence learning. (2) Recount on origin/main 6eddc569f: CSVs/site_raw/fantasyProsIdp.csv has 319 rows and 9 duplicated names (the docs record 15 on 2026-09-30 and 16 on 2026-09-23). (3) Production /api/status 2026-10-26: source_counts fantasyProsIdp 271, flag ON. (4) My computation, not a repo figure: at 2026-10-26T12:00Z the vendor clock is 1,257 h old; with the 253 h expected interval recorded in the 10-18 closeout the C4 curve in freshness_v1.json gives freshness about 0.111 (it was 0.18 on 10-18). The 0.02 quarantine line would be crossed about 79 days after 2026-09-04, roughly 2026-11-22, if the cadence estimate stays at 253 h and the vendor publishes nothing.
items.evaluationCriteria: Pre-existing: owner D5 text (the analysis must show no artificial vote amplification without suppressing legitimately independent material) and freshness_v1 (quarantineBelow 0.02; stateBands 0.95 / 0.7 / 0.3). No numeric acceptance threshold exists for the duplicate analysis itself: NONE_DEFINED for that part.

On the 10-18 board FantasyPros IDP freshness moved 0.58 -> 0.18 (SEVERELY_STALE), 0 values moved because it is the lone subgroup member of the IDP blend, and confidence labels changed on 142 IDP rows, buckets unchanged.

items.name: KTC/IDPTC last_success freshness stamps come from the GH-runner scrape, not the box scrape that serves data
items.objective: Establish which writer owns each source's fetch-success stamp (data/scrape_state/<key>_last_success), which readers use it, and whether the 'fetched' clock on /api/status and in the confidence freshness axis can disagree with the content clock that actually weights votes.
items.currentImplementation: Writers (grep of origin/main): .github/workflows/scheduled-refresh.yml run_fetcher stamps only on fetcher exit 0 (exit 4 seasonal and failures write nothing) for the KTC family (ktc, ktcSfTep, ktcCrowdSfTep, ktcTradesSfTep, ktcCrowdTradesSfTep), idpTradeCalc, draftSharks, draftSharksIdp and the HTTP fetchers. Box timers write dlf (deploy/dlf_fetch_and_push.sh), idpShow / idpShowCombined (deploy/idpshow_fetch_and_push.sh) and signals (src/sources/signals.py). Dynasty Scraper.py writes only sleeper_last_success. No box writer exists for the KTC, IDPTC or DraftSharks stamps. Readers: server._per_source_freshness (the /api/status source_health block) and data_contract._build_source_timestamps both prefer the stamp over CSV mtime; _source_freshness_flags turns it into a fresh / stale flag against _SOURCE_MAX_AGE_HOURS (6 h for ktc*, idpTradeCalc, draftSharks*, dynastyNerds, fantasyCalc, etc.), and _family_evidence_for_row hands that flag to the B11 confidence gate's freshness axis. Vote weight does not read the stamp: freshness_v1 reads src/sources/dataset_state.py (the content clock, a different clock by design).
items.evidenceCollected: (1) Production /api/status 2026-10-26T11:37Z: lastFetched 2026-10-25T12:03:37Z (23.56 h) for ktc, ktcSfTep, ktcCrowdSfTep, ktcTradesSfTep, ktcCrowdTradesSfTep and idpTradeCalc; 2026-10-25T12:06:15Z (23.52 h) for draftSharks and draftSharksIdp; every other source 3.5-5.2 h. The stamp files on origin/main match, last committed by github-actions[bot] in 34bc0deea 'chore: freshness stamps' at 2026-10-25T12:06:57Z. The hint's 8.16 h / 19:08Z figures were an earlier moment of the same condition. (2) The 24 h hard-stale threshold in config/source_staleness.json (ktc, idpTradeCalc, draftSharks) is crossed at 12:03Z and 12:06Z today. #1939 (6eddc569f, merged 11:33Z) pins runs-on ubuntu-24.04; at 11:39Z no run had started since 08:07Z, the first scheduled run is about 12:42Z. Capture only; no consumer, no weighting.

The prototype was PR #921 (2 commits, a source_rank lane, proven non-influencing with golden_board), CLOSED 2026-09-09 as 'DEFER / PRESERVE REFERENCE' in docs/OPEN_PR_DISPOSITION_LEDGER_2026-09-09.md ('current main should receive a fresh implementation when that capture lane is authorized'). EXECUTION_PLAN section 0.4b (2026-08-18) says capture is AUTHORIZED, post-V1. docs/lane4/LANE4_804_CAPTURE_CADENCE_DECISION.md on main says 'awaiting an owner decision' on daily (3.2 MB/day) versus every build (38.8 MB/day) and states 'the capture unit shipped in #921 and its feature flag is OFF', which is false: #921 never merged.
items.evidenceCollected: (1) gh: PR #921 state CLOSED, mergedAt null, closed by the owner account 2026-09-09; no later PR, branch, work-claim or CQ row for rank-digest capture (git branch -r, gh pr search, WORK_CLAIMS and COMPLETION_QUEUE grep). (2) Issue #804 itself is titled 'Correlated-source / shared-lineage anomaly protection', open since 2026-08-11, labels lane-4-market and post-v1, zero comments; its body asks for source-independence measurement, lineage families, correlated-failure detection and family caps, and sets non-goals (no arbitrary weights, no corridor restoration). The rank-digest capture is the evidence prerequisite named by EXECUTION_PLAN 0.4b and docs/lane4/LANE4_804_CORRELATED_SOURCE_STATUS.md, which reconciles the two descriptions. (3) Perishability is partly overstated. exports/archive on main holds 151 daily bundles (2026-07-14 to 2026-10-25), but each bundle's contract carries only 3 sources in _canonicalSiteValues (ktc, ktcSfTep, idpTradeCalc) and the newest bundle adds 7 more browser-fetched site_raw CSVs. The source-quality evaluator already builds its 522,206-cell panel from that history (PREREGISTRATION section 0). items.name: Outlier integrity V2 / V2.1: layered source validation (gates the DLF IDP, D4 and freshness-v2 restorations)
items.objective: Replace the incumbent per-player Hampel outlier filter's one-size-fits-all rejection with layered validation: A identity, B source integrity and normalization, C disagreement-preserving guards, plus confidence. The aim is that legitimate dissent keeps its vote while corrupt, wrong-player and wrong-scale votes are caught. Passing it is the precondition for the owner to consider lifting the DLF IDP hold (dlf_offense_only_vote), activating D4 (dlf_values_rank_hill_vote) and activating the freshness schedule (source_freshness_schedule_v2). Each of those is reserved for the owner (owner directive 2026-10-20, IV2-1..13, IV2-A, IV2-D4, FS-B7).

1. Owner Option 3 items 4-7: all six existing adversarial tests pass unweakened; regression coverage for Trevin Wallace, Myles Garrett and every defender whose valid votes were discarded; legitimate DS/FP/IDPTC/DLF disagreement not removed; determinism, family caps and small-sample handling; an exact before/after report; a shadow run on the current production board.
2. IV2-9 (docs/OWNER_REQUESTED_TODO.md:203) and V2 preregistration §15 activation criteria R1-R10 (one DLF family cap, populations, rookie translation, not misclassified as an outlier, DS/FP/IDPTC still vote, confidence, IDP consistency, two-way, downstream pick/trade values).
3. For the dependency filter: docs/sources/OUTLIER_INTEGRITY_V21_PREREGISTRATION.md §7 (ARRIVING gate of record per owner IV21-O1; §7.4 cold-start safety over the 31 IDP votes) and §12.

items.name: IDP deep-tail native-value challenger (PROMOTION-ELIGIBLE but blocked)
items.objective: Answer owner Decision 6 (2026-10-18, ODR-IDP-DEEP-TAIL): for IDP shared_market rank votes at effective rank 500 < r <= 904, does pricing them at the IDP Trade Calculator's own native value for that rank (an isotonic ladder) give a better-calibrated board than the incumbent Hill/B4-tail extrapolation, without harming rank order, position balance, source independence or stability? The owner's bar is that the incumbent stays unless the challenger "convincingly improves" it. The tail saturation rank (904) and the global coordinate may not change as a side effect.
items.origin: Finding N-1 of docs/sources/IDP_REHABILITATION_EVALUATION_2026-10-18.md §3: past rank 500, the median ln(native/Hill) is -0.336 (x0.71, n=232 IDPTC votes). This became owner closeout 2026-10-18 PART 2 Decision 6, "RUN A CHALLENGER" (docs/owner/OWNER_DECISION_CLOSEOUT_2026-10-18.md lines ~158-170), registered as ODR-IDP-DEEP-TAIL in docs/owner/OWNER_DECISION_REGISTER.md. The offline outlier challenger rows for the deep tail were merged into this initiative.
items.currentImplementation: Merged to main and dormant. src/canonical/deep_tail_native.py holds the ladder build (PAVA, linear interpolation, band 500<r<=904, which derives from PERCENTILE_REFERENCE_N and TAIL_SATURATION_RANK). data_contract.py has two seams (around lines 11484-11512 and 12983-13214), active only when flag idp_deep_tail_native_challenger is true. The flag defaults to False in src/api/feature_flags.py:312 and is gate-classed LIVE (a challenger that ships OFF). Replay harness: scripts/idp_evidence_challengers.py (backfill / evaluate-deep-tail) plus src/robust_filter_shadow/idp_challengers.py. Tests: tests/api/test_idp_deep_tail_native_challenger.py, 7 tests, including OFF byte-identical with no ladder built, ON reprices only deep IDP shared-market rank votes, and within-source order preserved. Commits: 341099255 (prereg, 20:11Z), 58161d8e0 (implementation, 20:33Z), 5a8d8a726 (results, 21:28Z), all on 2026-10-18. These shipped in PR #1815 (merge d59d5f1) inside release train 9, PR #1820. Production commit ed59d0dc6 contains d59d5f1, and /api/status reports featureFlags.idp_deep_tail_native_challenger.enabled=false. Nothing on the box runs it: data/idp_evidence_challengers/ does not exist there, and no timer for it exists.
items.dataCollected: A one-shot historical replay of 105 complete frozen archive boards (2026-08-18 23:02Z to 2026-10-18 11:47Z), from the frozen manifest of idp-outlier-n3-2026-10-18 (sha256 0a3d5c1f…). Every board went through one clean code revision (58161d8e02), with four builds per board: incumbent, n3, DLF hold off, deep-tail. Results are in docs/valuation/evidence/idp-deep-tail-native-2026-10-18/evaluation_historical_replay.json, which covers C1/B1/R1/H1, secondary horizons, families, per-board rails, structural guards, S1-S9 and D1-D5. Per-board ledger records (data/idp_evidence_challengers/) are gitignored and were produced locally, not on the box.
items.dataQuantity: 105/105 complete boards; C1 16,223 evaluable votes, 54 origin days, 8 week-blocks at h=7; R1 54 origin days with a mean of 166 rows. Repriced votes: Draft Sharks IDP 16,269, FantasyPros IDP 9,692, IDP Show combined 8,320. S1 used all 140 archives.
items.collectionMechanism: Manual, offline replay: `python scripts/idp_evidence_challengers.py backfill --shard 0/2|1/2`, then `evaluate-deep-tail --out …`. The dataset is frozen by preregistration §2 ("Boards added later are excluded"), so no continuous shadow and no scheduled job exist by design.
items.evaluationCriteria: Pre-existing and preregistered: docs/valuation/evidence/idp-deep-tail-native-2026-10-18/PREREGISTRATION.md, committed in 341099255 before the implementation and results. §3 verdict table. PROMOTION-ELIGIBLE requires all of: C1 upper95<0 at h=7; C1<0 at >=2 of 3 secondary horizons; C1<=0 in every family with >=30 votes; R1 lower95>=-0.005; H1 upper95<=1.10; S/scope guards hold; Hill Autopilot boardImpact rails hold on every complete board. NOT BETTER and INCONCLUSIVE are defined in the same table. Minimum sample: C1 >=200 votes, >=10 days, >=4 blocks; R1 >=10 days with >=30 rows. Thresholds come from idp-hampel-n3-v1, the per-vote experiment, and maxBoardWorseningFraction 0.10 in config/model_registry/hill_autopilot_policy.json. Two further layers apply on top. Governance overlay: gate 7 of docs/valuation/HILL_AUTOPILOT_V2.md requires an eligible independent validation target. §6: PROMOTION-ELIGIBLE leads only to an independent fresh-context review and an owner decision. The owner's qualitative bar is "convincingly improves" (D6), and no numeric definition of it exists.
items.existingResults:
Verdict PROMOTION-ELIGIBLE, with all 7 checks true and no NOT BETTER trigger. C1 h7 -0.0703 [-0.0722,-0.0681]. Secondary horizons 3/3 negative. Families: DL -0.0374, LB -0.0730, DB -0.1008. R1 -0.00078 [-0.00168,+0.00010]. H1 0.959 [0.931,0.991]. Rails 105/105. Guards: 0 violations. Governance overlay: AUTO_PROMOTION_BLOCKED: no_independent_validation_target.

The README states caveats from the same run:
(1) C1 grades against the challenger's own provider (IDPTC). The gain is mostly level, with median signed log error going from +0.253 to +0.207, so the over-pricing is narrowed, not closed.
(2) The non-circular R1 is flat or slightly negative. S1 is -0.00158 [-0.00291,-0.00041], with upper95<0. S3 LB is -0.00043 [-0.00077,-0.00013].
(3) A discontinuity at the band edge: N(500.5)/Hill(500) is about 1.046, giving about 200 within-source order inversions at the boundary across 105 boards.
(4) Confidence goes net more low: 1,423 rows medium to low, 1,016 low to medium.
(5) S6 has only 7 votes.
Author recommendation: retain the incumbent. If the direction is wanted, preregister a continuous variant to be judged on boards published after its registration.

items.statusExplanation: The preregistered experiment is complete, and its verdict and governance overlay are final under §6. More of the same data cannot change the outcome. Gate 7 is structurally unsatisfiable for IDP today: DLF IDP depends measurably on IDPTC, the IDP Show order copies IDPTC, and the target registry is empty. So v1 cannot be auto-promoted at any sample size. Under §6 the only remaining steps are (a) an independent fresh-context review and (b) an owner decision. No record of either exists. items.qA_enoughToDecide: YES for the decision that is actually available: retain the incumbent and close v1, or commission a new preregistered continuous variant. The frozen rule was met on a full sample. Its weaknesses are already measured and documented: the circular C1, the flat or slightly negative independent R1/S1/LB, and the rank-500 step. Gate 7 makes activation impossible without an independent target that more data would not create. The evidence is NOT enough for activation: no independent IDP target exists, and the replay predates later pipeline changes. For example, production now has fantasypros_idp_upstream_clock=true, which the replay did not pin. So the result might need re-measuring on current boards (INFERRED).
items.qC_authorized: Development, shadow replay and dormant merge were authorized by owner closeout 2026-10-18 D6 and EXECUTION_PLAN.md §0 ("Authorized now … challengers … D6"). Production activation is NOT authorized. EXECUTION_PLAN.md §0 lists "any deep-tail … replacement (D6…)" under "Conditional activations — gates still apply", and PREREGISTRATION §6 plus HILL_AUTOPILOT_V2 gate 7 require an independent review, an owner decision and an eligible independent target. Owner approval is required and has not been granted. No owner decision on the v1 result is recorded (register and intake both read EVIDENCE_PENDING).
items.decisionPossibleNow: Yes, an owner decision is possible now. Recommended: record D6 as "incumbent retained; idp-deep-tail-native-v1 closed, flag stays OFF". Optionally direct whether the deep-tail level question should go into the starting IDP valuation accuracy program (RPA-VAL-013) as a newly preregistered continuous variant judged on post-registration boards. Before or alongside that, run a short independent fresh-context review per §6 to confirm the retain recommendation. That review is routine engineering under existing authorization.
items.priorityReason: Production is unaffected: the flag is OFF and the incumbent is served. Activation is blocked by gate 7 whatever is decided, so nothing urgent depends on this. It is worth closing because it is the only valuation challenger that passed its own frozen rule. Leaving it as "PROMOTION-ELIGIBLE, EVIDENCE_PENDING" invites misreading it as a pending win, and it is a direct input to the new IDP accuracy program (RPA-VAL-013).
items.recommendation: Retain the incumbent Hill/B4 tail and close idp-deep-tail-native-v1 without activation. The only clear gain, C1, is calibration against the challenger's own provider. The one non-circular target is flat and slips on S1 and LB. v1 adds a ~5% discontinuity at rank 500 with about 200 boundary order inversions, which is a defect any promotion would have to repair through a new variant. Confidence shifts net toward low. None of this meets "convincingly improves", and gate 7 cannot be satisfied for IDP today. If the owner wants the direction pursued, fold it into RPA-VAL-013: preregister a continuous (no rank-500 step) variant, evaluate it on boards published after registration against the current pipeline, and first establish whether any independent IDP validation target can exist (for example realized-outcome or completed-trade evidence). Do not invent a target or threshold. Also correct the stale status rows: register ODR-IDP-DEEP-TAIL and intake D6, both still EVIDENCE_PENDING.

Activation would concentrate deep-tail IDP pricing on one provider. Pipeline drift: the replay pinned the 2026-10-18 incumbent, and production has changed since (for example fantasypros_idp_upstream_clock=true), so the replay numbers may not hold today (INFERRED). The stale register and intake rows risk a future session treating it as pending activation.
items.blockers: (1) Governance: AUTO_PROMOTION_BLOCKED: no_independent_validation_target. The gate-7 registry is empty, and DLF IDP and IDP Show are measured-dependent on IDPTC. (2) Process: the §6 independent fresh-context review has not been recorded. (3) Authority: an owner decision on the v1 result has not been recorded. (4) Methodology: v1's rank-500 step would need a new preregistered variant; it cannot be fixed by tweaking v1.

All four experiments are closed with terminal preregistered verdicts that keep the champion: NOT BETTER, INCONCLUSIVE (closed, no follow-up implied), INSUFFICIENT (closed, direction unfavourable) and NOT ELIGIBLE (owner-rejected). Every flag is OFF in production (/api/status 2026-10-25, build ed59d0dc6), and nothing records them. Two things remain:

That is worth cleaning up, but it does not block anything and is not urgent. V2 work (RPA-VAL-001) carries the real value.
items.recommendation:
Treat these as closed, superseded experiments and retire them in two steps:
1. Now: remove the rank-space whole, per-vote and IDP n=3 challenger branches, flags, record kinds and harness variants. Preserve the evidence directories and preregistrations unchanged. Prove the default board is byte-identical (scripts/board_diff.py --expect-no-value-change).
2. Keep outlier_disagreement_policy (V1, outlier_policy.py) dormant only until outlier-integrity V2/V2.1 (#1884, RPA-VAL-001) concludes, because the owner directive requires V1 as a comparator. Then delete it in the same or a follow-up PR.
Until deletion: consider adding these four flags to the OWNER_HELD_FLAGS deploy check, or to a hold-lock test, so an env line cannot silently activate a rejected filter. Do not re-run or re-tune any of them; their preregistrations forbid follow-up variants.

items.evaluationCriteria:
Preregistered in docs/valuation/evidence/joint-filter-shadow-2026-10-01/PREREGISTRATION.md §5, committed in bfcf2e423 before any outcome was computed. The §9 addendum applies the same rules to live records.
- Minimum sample: at least 30 evaluable observations in each of K and X at h = 7, from at least 10 distinct origin days, covering at least 4 week-blocks. Below that the verdict is INSUFFICIENT.
- PROMOTION-ELIGIBLE (pending independent review): Δ lower95 > 0 AND G1 upper95 ≤ +0.005 AND Δ > 0 at ≥ 2 of 3 secondary horizons (3, 14, 21 days).
- NOT BETTER: Δ upper95 < 0 OR G1 lower95 > 0.
- INCONCLUSIVE: anything else that meets the minimum sample. Near-ties keep the incumbent.
- Method: 7-day block bootstrap, 4,000 resamples, seed 1571. Accumulation projection uses a minimum effect of interest |Δ| = 0.10.
- Promotion policy is EXECUTION_PLAN Section N: a passed preregistered, leakage-safe, independently reviewed gate, never a lowered one.
- No preregistered stop or close rule exists for this experiment: NONE_DEFINED. The per-vote rank-space sibling's preregistration, by contrast, closed that experiment on INCONCLUSIVE.

items.qA_enoughToDecide:
PARTIAL. There is enough trustworthy, pinned and preregistered evidence to decide not to promote and to stop expecting the live pairing to deliver the primary test:
- the historical minimum was met with a precise near-zero Δ;
- the live h=7 pairing is structurally unsatisfiable under current churn.
There is not enough evidence to claim the filters are equivalent: no equivalence rule was preregistered, the outcome measure has little range, and 6-block intervals probably under-cover. Nor is there enough to claim an offense-only advantage, because S3 is post-hoc.
items.qC_authorized:
The shadow experiment is AUTHORIZED: EXECUTION_PLAN line 884 (Unit F, wave 2) and OWNER_REQUESTED_TODO line 1623 ("Joint robust filter as a real shadow experiment with an archived ledger | AUTHORIZED, wave 2"). The dormant merge was authorized by owner decision B (#1555 Batch 2 Unit C).
Production activation is NOT authorized. It requires a passed preregistered gate plus independent review (Section N), and that gate failed to pass. No owner record grants activation, and no record found closes or retires the experiment or the box timer.
Retiring the timer or closing the experiment has no preregistered rule (unlike the per-vote rank-space sibling). It should be recorded as a coordinator/owner disposition, not done silently.

items.recommendation:
Do not promote joint-robust-v2. Close the primary live-pairing evaluation as unable to yield preregistered evidence; that is the design limit §9 itself foresaw. Concretely:
1. Run the already-authorized decisive re-test once (`backfill --include-degraded` + `evaluate --sensitivities` under one code revision) over the archive that now extends to 2026-10-25, and commit the artifact as a fresh application of the unchanged §5 rule.
2. If that is still INCONCLUSIVE or NOT BETTER, record the experiment CLOSED with the incumbent retained. Then either disable the dynasty-joint-filter-shadow timer or relabel it explicitly as census-only (safeguard firing and disagreement counts), so it is not reported as accumulating decision evidence.
3. Route the post-hoc offense-vs-IDP split into the outlier-integrity-v2/V2.1 lane as a new preregistered hypothesis rather than reviving this lane. Do not "fix" the pairing by relaxing the fingerprint: that would compare votes across value-code versions, which §9 forbids for good reason.
items.nextAction: Coordinator/owner disposition decision: authorize one final decisive backfill re-run, then close and retire, or relabel the live timer as census-only. That run is already authorized under PREREGISTRATION §9 and needs full git history (about 7 minutes). Record the disposition in OWNER_REQUESTED_TODO / EXECUTION_PLAN.

items.name: Sparse-evidence estimator challenger (Batch 3 Unit E) and the single-source haircut collapse
items.objective: Replace the 0.30 single-source haircut, which applies the same treatment to evidence states 1-9, with candidate C. Candidate C keeps a single-family row's observation as its central value, carries uncertainty separately (evidenceState, LOW confidence, an uncalibrated interval) and lets healthy absent families bound the value from above at their cutoffs. It must fix the 4600->1380 trap without the x3.33 deep-board explosion (EXECUTION_PLAN Batch 3 unit E). It is linked to CQ-10 / owner intake V6, which rejects the extreme haircut collapses (L'Jarius Sneed 1,133->339, Travis Hunter 4,692->2,224). V6 keeps the approved rule and allows a revision only as a gated challenger.

items.qA_enoughToDecide: PARTIAL. There is enough to decide that candidate C as preregistered must not be promoted: G2c failed and gates cannot be lowered (VERIFIED). There is also enough for the owner to answer the semantics question: should uncontradicted single-family rows keep their observation? That is a methodology choice, and the state matrix and census make it explicit. There is not enough to decide on a successor, because no outcome evaluation is preregistered and none has run on the 47 records.
items.qC_authorized: Batch 3 unit E implementation, the shadow and the dormant merge are authorized (EXECUTION_PLAN Batch 3 owner directive 2026-10-01; OWNER_REQUESTED_TODO line 1622 "AUTHORIZED, wave 2"). Under Batch 3 §N, promotion is pre-authorized only after a preregistered, leakage-safe, independently reviewed gate passes; that has not happened. Changing the haircut rule otherwise is owner-only (V6 DECIDED 2026-10-19: keep the existing rule; revisions only as gated challengers). The README's owner decisions 1 and 2 have no recorded answer: owner approval required, not granted. A successor preregistration could proceed under the Batch 3 "recurring evidence accumulation / preregistered challengers" mandate, but its semantic premise (decision 1) is owner-reserved.
items.priorityReason: The incumbent haircut stays live and safe, so nothing user-facing breaks while this waits. The work feeds the haircut fairness concern (V6/CQ-10) and the new IDP valuation accuracy program, since most scoped rows are deep IDP. The recorder is cheap (about 2.3 MB a month) but produces nothing decisive without a preregistration.
items.recommendation: Ask the owner for one decision: should a single-family row that no healthy absent family contradicts keep its observation as the central value, with uncertainty carried separately? This is README owner decision 1. If yes: preregister an outcome-based successor before anyone scores the ledger. It should fix a horizon and target in advance (later canonical value once more families list the player), use a proper loss, include rows that never gain a second family, define calibration checks for the bounds and interval, and carry G1, G2a, G2b and G3-G6 forward unchanged in place of G2c. Use only ledger records that predate their outcomes, and handle the per-record code-revision changes and the workingTreeDirty=true flag. Keep the recorder running until then. If no: retire candidate C, stop the timer, and leave the 0.30 rule as champion. Either way, coordinate with the IDP valuation accuracy program, because 39 of the 48 scoped rows are IDP and the population is dominated by a source-hold artifact. Separately, close CQ-10 by attributing the Sneed and Travis Hunter collapses on the current post-#1817 board (grouping versus haircut). Do not route CQ-10 through this estimator.
items.nextAction: Record the owner's answer to README decision 1, using the state-8 census and the current shadow population as the decision brief. Meanwhile, under existing authority, run a read-only CQ-10 attribution on the current board: are Sneed and Travis Hunter still haircut, and was the cause D2 grouping or the haircut?
items.ifPromoted: With sparse_evidence_estimator ON, about 48 single-family rows (mostly deep IDP plus a few WR/RB/TE) would publish about 3.3x their current haircut value. G2a and G2b show none enter the top-400, but the deep IDP tail, the Hill tail and IDP trade/FAAB numbers would move. Confidence stays LOW and evidenceState would be stamped on rows.
items.wouldModify: src/api/data_contract.py (_apply_sparse_evidence_estimator replacing the single-source haircut), rankDerivedValue for single-family rows, the sparseEvidence block in /api/data, src/api/source_weighting_explain.py, value_replay, and downstream trade/FAAB/draft consumers of those values.
items.risks: Promoting C as is would inflate uncontradicted deep-IDP rows about 3.33x by construction. The interval is uncalibrated. When many families bound a row, the observation stops ordering players inside the cluster (disclosed limitation). Nicknames and Sleeper-id-less sources can still miss a join, which risks a wrong censor (disclosed residual). The shadow population is dominated by a source-inactive listing artifact rather than censor states, so any outcome result would mostly describe a hold effect. Running the recorder indefinitely without an evaluator is dead telemetry.
items.blockers: No preregistered successor or outcome criteria (NONE_DEFINED). Owner decision 1 (semantics) unanswered. CQ-10 attribution not done on the current board.
items.decisionPossibleNow: Yes, for the owner: whether to accept C's keep-the-observation semantics, which decides between a successor preregistration and retiring the recorder. Also yes: do not promote C as preregistered (already settled by G2c). No: promoting a successor, since there is no evidence or gate yet.

items.name: Rank-form curve drift: stale reconstruction Hill constants (#898)
items.objective: Keep the legacy rank-form Hill constants accurate enough that reconstructed values match the served board. The constants are HILL_MIDPOINT/HILL_SLOPE (65.4/0.910) and IDP_HILL_MIDPOINT/IDP_HILL_SLOPE (64.6/0.900) in src/canonical/player_valuation.py, mirrored as RANK_FORM_CURVE in frontend/lib/value-history.js. "Accurate enough" is the pre-existing budget of excess RMSE of at most 25 per scope against the refit optimum. Alternatively, retire the reconstruction where persisted values already exist. The constants are reconstruction-only: they do not feed rankDerivedValue.
items.origin: PR #654 (merged 2026-07-30) re-tuned the constants from 48.44/1.149, which had RMSE 821.8. The same PR added scripts/check_rank_form_drift.py and the weekly .github/workflows/audit-rank-form-drift.yml (Tue 07:41 UTC). The first drift run, 32114681240 on 2026-08-18, opened issue #898. #1672 was a duplicate tracker filed by run 37479152470 on 2026-10-06 because of the 50-issue lookup window; it was closed NOT_PLANNED on 2026-10-07. CQ-28 in docs/COMPLETION_QUEUE.md (as of 2026-10-19) folds this in.
items.currentImplementation:
The live code paths on origin/main (a20de7020) that read the constants are below, all VERIFIED by reading the code.
(1) frontend/lib/value-history.js computeTeamValueSeries is the ACTIVE user-visible consumer, called by frontend/components/terminal/TeamValueChart.jsx and by the TeamCommandHeader.jsx 7/30-day deltas. normalizePoints keeps only {date,t,rank} and drops the persisted value, so the team value is always rebuilt from rank with the stale RANK_FORM_CURVE (valueFromRank(hit.rank)). This happens even though the rank_history entries carry real values.
(2) PlayerRankHistoryChart.jsx uses rankFromValue, the inverse, only to derive ranks for dates that have a value but no rank.
(3) src/api/terminal.py has two uses. _row_value's last fallback calls rank_to_value_for_scope; the code comment says it is dormant (0 of 740 rows on 2026-07-29), and its current state is UNVERIFIED. The historical roster sum (around line 702) uses value-history first and falls back to the rank-history Hill curve.
(4) src/api/rank_history.py _value_from_rank backfills only legacy entries that have no stored value. Every box entry sampled, from 2026-07-20 to 2026-10-25, appears to carry a values map, so this path is INFERRED to be dormant on production.
Monitoring: the drift script reuses scripts/backtest_legacy_rank_curve.py, prints the refit constants, and the workflow comments on #898 by design rather than auto-patching (ADR-008). Guard tests are tests/canonical/test_rank_form_constants_tripwire.py and tests/api/test_rank_form_frontend_parity.py.

items.name: Multi-bridge IDP ladder (Lane 8 PR-B, Draft Sharks beside IDPTC)
items.objective: Stop the offense-to-IDP translation from depending on one source. Today idpTradeCalc is the only seed of the shared-market ladder that turns IDP-only specialist ranks (dlfIdp, idpShow, fantasyProsIdp) into combined-market values. PR-B added an unconditional repair: an IDP-only source with no usable bridge casts no vote instead of an untranslated one. It also added the `multi_bridge_ladder` flag. With the flag ON, every QUALIFIED and capable bridge seeds the ladder together (today IDPTC plus Draft Sharks, with offense and IDP counted as one family), combined by the existing count-aware mean-median. This initiative is only about whether to switch that flag on.
items.origin: The cross-position bridge and IDP ceiling audit (PR #950, docs/sources/CROSS_POSITION_SOURCE_AND_IDP_CEILING_AUDIT_2026-08-20.md). It measured that losing idpTradeCalc caused 661 untranslated votes and put the top IDP at 9,999. The owner chartered Lane 8 on 2026-08-20 (docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md:1089-1106). Lane 8 PR A (#954, merged 2026-08-20) built the bridge owner src/bridges/. Lane 8 PR B (#993, merged 2026-08-20 as 000a9f14a) added the ladder, the withholding repair and the flag. V1-133 to V1-135 were promoted to VERIFIED at L2 by #1023 on 2026-08-21.

items.objective: Produce a separately named, league-scoped "Brisket League Fair Value" on the canonical 1-9999 scale. It may ship only if the pre-registered gate in scripts/validate_consensus_edge_board.py shows that following the served top-20 beats the cohort and a random-20 draw (ADR-017/022/023).
items.origin: Built 2026-08-04 (commits d26e0101b..87dad117e). The flag was turned ON that day based on a top-20 study (+3.59%). The same day an audit (#700, ADR-021) found that the IDP fair values had no scale. On the repaired board the same gate failed, and ADR-023 put the flag back OFF. The fix recovery (#734), playerctx retention (ADR-026) and the Sharp Score repairs (ADR-027..029) followed on 08-05. Owner inventory 4.1 says 'KEEP — EXISTING, REPAIR/COMPLETE'. Manifest C6-EDGE-01 is PARTIAL with acceptance 'ship gate passed'.
items.currentImplementation: Code lives in src/consensus_edge/ (17 modules: fair_value, mispricing, sharp_flow, opportunity, score, service, snapshot, panel, backtest, outcomes, api, ...). The /api/consensus-edge/* router is mounted in server.py and answers 503 feature_disabled when the flag is off. The flag is _DEFAULTS 'consensus_edge': False in src/api/feature_flags.py:701; its gate-registry status is LIVE, which means the gate is wired, not that the feature is on. tests/test_feature_flags.py keeps it in off_only. frontend/lib/nav-model.js gates the nav OFFER, not the route. Params in config/consensus_edge/params_v1.json: weights mispricing 0.5 (a prior), sharpFlow 0.3 (a prior that cannot be validated), opportunity 0.0 (measured null). On the live box only mispricing contributes ('components live: mispricing'). Model version is ce.2026-08-04.v0-shadow, params b90ef7db61a10905. Model Lab CE_FAMILY (src/model_registry/model_lab.py:1894) reads only the committed docs/measurements/consensus-edge-board-validation-*.json and maps 'do not ship yet' to champion_retained.
items.collectionMechanism: Two separate data paths. (1) The box timer dynasty-consensus-edge-snapshot.timer (daily, ~07:30 UTC) runs scripts/snapshot_consensus_edge.py. Each run writes that day's served board into data/consensus_edge.sqlite, then fills h7/h14/h30 cohort-excess outcomes for snapshots whose horizon has passed. (2) The weekly GitHub workflow consensus-edge-revalidate.yml (Wed 05:40 UTC, fetch-depth 0) rebuilds past boards from git history through the panel module (panel.available_dates / panel_day with csv_root redirected) and re-runs validate_consensus_edge_board.py at h7 and h14. It does NOT read the box store. It compares only the verdict string against the committed 2026-08-04 measurements, and by design it never commits fresh results; they go to a 30-day artifact.
items.dataCollected: Box store: one row per player per day for the served board (score, label, conviction, component values incl. component_sharp_flow, market_value), plus forward cohort-excess outcomes at 7/14/30 days. CI panel: boards rebuilt from committed CSVs/exports for 2026-04-16 to 2026-10-21 (189 dates).

items.existingResults: Committed (the gate of record), docs/measurements/consensus-edge-board-validation-2026-08-04-h7/h14.json: 'do not ship yet'. The h14 top-20 median was -1.01%, beating random in 0/6 folds; h7 was -0.55%, 0/12. Fresh CI re-run 2026-10-21 (run 39585633029, artifact only, not committed): h14 top-20 median -0.38% over 12 folds, 3/12 positive, beat random 6/12; tradeable (value >= 2000) median -0.28%; only IDP shows a positive class. h7: median +0.06% over 25 folds, beat random 10/25; tradeable -0.39%. DECISION 'do not ship yet' at both horizons. The 2026-10-07 h7 run computed +0.20% over 23 folds, beat random 8/23, 'do not ship yet', then crashed. Strong Buy/Strong Sell buckets hold only 19/6 rows over 2 folds. No forward (box-store) validation result has ever been recorded.
items.firstEvidence: 2026-08-04: the panel backtest and board validation committed in docs/measurements (consensus-edge-*-2026-08-04-*.json). The box store's first date is 2026-08-04.
items.latestEvidence: 2026-10-25: box snapshot written (1107 rows, 727 scored, store at 90,073 rows / 54,170 outcomes). 2026-10-21: CI revalidation SUCCESS, both horizons 'do not ship yet'. 2026-10-25: production /api/status shows featureFlags.consensus_edge.enabled=false.
items.evaluationCriteria: Pre-registered, in scripts/validate_consensus_edge_board.py::_decide (ADR-017/022/023). Ship only if all of these hold: (a) the median cohort-excess of the served top-20 buys is > 0; (b) the top-20 beats a random-20 draw in more than half of the usable non-overlapping folds; (c) the edge is broad, meaning at least 2 positive asset classes when 2 or more classes are measurable. Classes count only with at least MIN_FOLDS_FOR_A_VERDICT = 3 folds (src/consensus_edge/backtest.py:49); fewer than 3 usable folds gives 'inconclusive'. The flag default may flip only when that gate passes on a re-run (ADR-023; feature_flags.py comment). No criteria are defined for the box-store forward validation (validate_components_forward.py has only a 20-pair/3-origin usability floor, not a ship bar): NONE_DEFINED for that path.

observations.current: CI panel: 12 usable 14-day folds, 25 usable 7-day folds (189 dates). Box store: 82 snapshot dates, 54,170 outcome-labelled rows. About 830 rows per horizon are labelled per day.
observations.required: Sample size is not the binding constraint: the gate's own floor is 3 usable folds, which is already exceeded at both horizons. The gate fails on effect size and breadth, not on sample. No larger sample requirement is defined.
observations.frequency: Box snapshot daily (07:30 UTC + up to 300 s random delay). CI revalidation weekly (Wednesday). A new 14-day fold arrives about every 2 weeks; a new 7-day fold weekly.
observations.shortfall: None against the defined fold floor. The shortfall is evidence quality: the forward store has no consumer and no ship criterion, and committed measurements are frozen at 2026-08-04.
observations.runningProcessWillSupply: Partly. The CI workflow will keep adding git-panel folds and re-checking the verdict string. The box collector will keep adding forward outcomes. But no scheduled process reads the box store (validate_components_forward.py is unscheduled, with no committed output), and nothing commits fresh gate results. So the accumulating forward outcomes do not currently feed any decision.
observations.window: Panel 2026-04-16 to 2026-10-21 (offseason-heavy; ADR-016 names this as a stated limit). Box store 2026-08-04 to 2026-10-25.

items.statusExplanation: Collection is active: the box timer last succeeded 2026-10-25 with exit 0, and the weekly CI re-run is green again since 2026-10-14. The feature is dormant: flag OFF in production. Every gate run so far, committed (08-04) and fresh (10-07 h7, 10-14, 10-21), returns 'do not ship yet' at both horizons. Stage 3: running (daily shadow snapshots labelled 'v0-shadow', no production effect while the flag is OFF). Stage 4: VERIFIED and authorized, because it is merged on main, the off_only flag test pins it, and the flag is OFF in production (/api/status). Stage 5: NOT reached and NOT authorized. ADR-023 makes the gate passing a precondition and it has not passed; there is no owner activation record. Stage 6: n/a.
items.qA_enoughToDecide: PARTIAL. YES for the narrow decision 'keep the flag OFF': the pre-registered gate has failed at both horizons on every run since the 08-04 repair, with fold counts well above its floor (12 and 25). NO for 'ship' or 'retire': the panel is offseason-heavy (ADR-016), only mispricing contributes (Sharp Flow cannot be validated, ADR-027; opportunity is zero-weighted), and the forward box-store evidence (54k labelled rows) has never been analyzed. No pre-registered retirement criterion exists.
items.qC_authorized: Activation (Stage 5): not authorized. ADR-023 (accepted 2026-08-04) and the feature_flags.py comment require validate_consensus_edge_board.py to pass on a re-run before the default can flip, and it has not passed. No owner activation record exists in docs/owner/. Dormant code and collection: authorized (ADR-012/023 keep the endpoints and snapshot timer; owner inventory 4.1 'KEEP — EXISTING, REPAIR/COMPLETE'). Repair work (C6-EDGE-01, acceptance 'ship gate passed'): docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md has no C6-EDGE-01 row I could find, so new Consensus Edge model work is UNVERIFIED as authorized. Only the backup coverage (AL-P2) and C6-SIG-01 reconciler (#1705) touched it. The owner P1 homepage ticker #784 is TODO and depends on canonical Buy/Sell output.
items.priorityReason: No user-facing effect while the flag is OFF, and the gate keeps returning a near-zero edge, so there is no urgency. It is not P3: owner P1 intake #784 (the homepage buy/sell ticker) and C6-EDGE-01 depend on this board having a measured edge, and about 54k forward outcomes are piling up unread.
items.recommendation: Keep consensus_edge OFF; the gate does not permit activation. Keep the daily collector running, since it is cheap, backed up and the only look-ahead-free evidence. Before any further judgement, close the evidence gap. (1) Pre-register a ship criterion for the forward box-store path, or declare that the panel gate stays the sole gate. (2) Schedule or run validate_components_forward.py read-only against data/consensus_edge.sqlite. (3) Have a human commit the latest re-run measurements (10-21), which ADR-023's workflow expects; the committed files still date from 08-04. If in-season folds keep failing, take a retire/redesign decision to the owner instead of letting the board idle forever behind a gate.
items.nextAction: Engineering, read-only: copy the store, run scripts/validate_components_forward.py against it on the box or a copy, and commit the 2026-10-21 h7/h14 board-validation artifacts with the verdict unchanged ('do not ship yet'). Owner decision: whether the forward store should become the gate of record, with a pre-registered criterion, before #784 can rely on this board.
items.ifPromoted: The /consensus-edge page and the /api/consensus-edge/* endpoints would serve buy/sell labels to users and could feed the #784 homepage ticker. On current evidence those calls carry no measured edge over a random draw (h14 -0.38%, beat random 6/12), and the tradeable slice is negative. The board is scoring-profile scoped, so it does not provide the roster-scoped SELL list #784 requires.
items.wouldModify: Only the default of the consensus_edge flag in src/api/feature_flags.py, which tests/test_feature_flags.py would also need to move from off_only. No canonical value changes: Consensus Edge never writes rankDerivedValue.
items.blockers: The pre-registered gate fails at both horizons; this is an effect-size blocker, not a sample blocker. Sharp Flow cannot be backtested because its corpus is survivorship-biased (ADR-027), so the board is effectively mispricing-only. Confidence is capped at 69.34, so Strong labels can't be reached. There is no ship criterion for the forward store (NONE_DEFINED). The snapTrend/opportunity arm is degraded by the depth-chart outage (COL-018, #1926), but opportunity carries weight 0.0, so this affects only the composite study arm, not the served board or the gate.
items.missingEvidence: (1) Any analysis of the 54,170 labelled forward outcomes in the box store. (2) A committed measurement newer than 2026-08-04. (3) In-season panel folds in volume: most 2026-04 to 2026-08 folds are offseason, and many show 0.00% movement. (4) Whether snapshots stamp a scoring fingerprint or league identity (UNVERIFIED; they stamp model version and params id). (5) Sharp Flow validity (structurally unobtainable historically, ADR-027).
items.decisionPossibleNow: Yes, a narrow one: 'keep OFF' is decidable and already in force under ADR-023. Owner decisions available now: whether to pre-register a forward-store ship and retire criterion, and whether #784 should wait on this board or on the C6-SIG-01 reconciler output.
items.risks: Measurements that read as 'monitored' while nothing checks the sample: the weekly workflow compares only verdict strings. A green run means 'still do not ship', not 'healthy'. Fresh results live in 30-day artifacts (the 10-14 artifact expires around mid-November) and are lost unless committed. The store grows about 1,100 rows a day (59.5 MB) with no consumer. The temptation to re-enable for #784 without the gate passing.
items.ownerApproval: Activation needs the gate to pass and then owner authorization; neither exists. ADR-023 (accepted 2026-08-04) records the flag-OFF decision. The ADR-026 playerctx retention push was enabled on explicit owner sign-off on 2026-08-05.

items.name: TE premium target basis is a constant, not league TE demand (2-TE calibration audit #785)
items.objective: Show that tight-end valuation is right for dynasty_main, a league with two mandatory TE starters (issue #785). The audit covers four things: the league's real scoring and starter demand, each source's TE basis (base, TEP or TE++), whether the KTC base-to-TE++ curve is still current, and that nothing is counted twice and no stale blanket multiplier survives. Separately, decide whether the board's constant TE++ target basis (Axis A, in the blend) should become a league-demand basis applied through an overlay (Axis B, ADR-009/ADR-015).
items.origin: ADR-009 and ADR-015 (docs/league-intelligence/DECISIONS.md; ADR-015 shipped 2026-07-27). The owner then filed binding audit issue #785 on 2026-08-11. It is carried in docs/OWNER_REQUESTED_TODO.md:402 (P1 methodology audit, status TODO), :415, :431 and :597, and in docs/OWNER_FEATURE_INVENTORY.md:416 ('KEEP — METHODOLOGY AUDIT / REPAIR'). It is reinforced by docs/owner/IDP_VALUATION_ACCURACY_DIRECTIVE_2026-10-25.md:45, which notes the 2026 card has no conventional TE reception premium.
items.currentImplementation:
VERIFIED (origin/main a20de7020):
- src/api/data_contract.py:9823 hard-codes _BOARD_TE_BASIS = "tepp" and _TE_SOURCE_DEFAULT_BASIS = "base".
- When the te_basis_conversion flag is on (default True and LIVE, src/api/feature_flags.py:464/966), non-TEP sources' TE votes are lifted with te_premium.convert_te_value(base->tepp). The curve is config/weights/te_premium_curve.json: a=43.56, k=0.633, floor 1.209, ceiling 2.053, n=73, R²(log)=0.941, measured_at 2026-07-27.
- TEP-native sources keep a flat 1.10. KTC TE++ boards are exempt.
- te_premium.measure_te_demand(roster, scoring) exists. It returns tepp for 2 mandatory TE starters, and scoring can only raise the basis. Its live consumers are faab_comparability (has_scoring_edge only) and replacement-level docs; it does not feed the blend.
- Axis B tePremium is a named ABSENT axis in src/league_intel/publish.py:45-65 and overlay.py:39.
- The fit is refreshed only by the manual scripts/audit/fit_ktc_tep_curve.py --write-config. No workflow or timer references it (git grep over .github/scripts/deploy).

items.evaluationCriteria: NONE_DEFINED. Issue #785 lists qualitative audit questions: league demand and scoring, a source-basis inventory, a fresh KTC re-measurement, no double counting, and validating elite through deep TE ranges against scarcity and realized scoring. Its success statement is 'evidence that values are right for this league, not merely closer to KTC'. No quantitative acceptance thresholds, holdout target or preregistration exist. Recommend preregistering the criteria before any challenger; do not invent thresholds.
items.statusExplanation:
The Axis A constant-basis conversion is live and working: flag ON, code path verified. The #785 audit, though, has never started. Nothing has happened on it since 2026-08-11, there is no work claim, it is not in EXECUTION_PLAN, and the curve has not been re-fit since 2026-07-27.

The stated reason for keeping the target basis constant is now largely obsolete, INFERRED from verified records:
- ADR-015 justified it because dynasty_main and dynasty_new 'share' the superflex_tep15_ppr1 board. Since W18-F001 (PR #810), rankings are shared only across leagues with proven-identical scoring fingerprints, and the two leagues' fingerprints differ.
- The owner's 2026-10-18 scope correction puts dynasty_new out of scope.
- The overlay that was to host Axis B has been withdrawn (#822 / B9a).
For dynasty_main, measure_te_demand's own mapping (2 mandatory TE starters → tepp; scoring adds nothing because bonus_rec_te = 0.0) gives exactly the constant in use. So the 'constant vs league demand' gap has no in-scope consumer. The substantive open question is the #785 one: is TE++ the correct basis for this league, given 2 TE starters and no TE scoring premium, and is the 2026-07-27 curve still representative?

items.qC_authorized: Not authorized for implementation. #785 appears only in owner intake (OWNER_REQUESTED_TODO.md:402, status TODO) and in the feature inventory (KEEP, at a future checkpoint). docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md has no TE-premium unit. Any change to TE values is a production valuation methodology change and needs owner approval (ADR / champion-challenger gates). Owner approval is required and has not been granted.
items.priorityReason: The owner marked #785 P1 in intake. However, the in-scope league's measured demand already equals the constant basis, and the Axis B gap affects only the out-of-scope dynasty_new. The remaining risk is an unvalidated, 3-month-old curve and an unexamined TE++-without-scoring-premium assumption. That matters for valuation accuracy but is not a live defect with demonstrated harm.
items.nextAction: Owner decision: (a) close or narrow the Axis B framing, and (b) add the #785 Stage-1 audit with preregistered acceptance criteria to EXECUTION_PLAN. After that, run scripts/audit/fit_ktc_tep_curve.py --json (no --write-config) against current CSVs as a read-only staleness check.
items.ifPromoted: If a re-fit or methodology change were promoted, every TE value and the current-year pick rows tethered to rookie TEs would move. Picks would move via the tether; QB/RB/WR/IDP would be unchanged per the ADR-015 pattern. That affects board ranks, trade calculations, the draft-capital rookie ladder and the FAAB anchors.
