items.name: Scoring-fit flags ON for a withdrawn lens (idp_scoring_fit, reception_scoring_fit) and player-specific scoring fit (#803)
items.objective: Determine whether any served surface still consumes idp_scoring_fit and reception_scoring_fit now that the league-adjusted lens they feed was withdrawn from canonical value (#822 / B9a, 2026-08-14), clean up what is orphaned, and carry issue #803 (a validated player-specific scoring fit versus a standard-market baseline, then college translation) as the successor.
items.currentImplementation: Both flags default True with gate status LIVE (src/api/feature_flags.py:494, :537, :989-990); production /api/status 2026-10-26 reports both enabled true. They are read in exactly two places, both in src/api/gameplan.py (_resolve_reception_fit line 1422, _resolve_scoring_fit line 1543), which feed get_league_adjusted_values and so GET /api/valuation/league-adjusted (login-required; anonymous returns 401). That endpoint returns a separate overlay payload and does not mutate the contract. The shipped client never calls it: frontend/lib/dynasty-data.js hard-codes leagueAdjusted = false and frontend/lib/valuation-mode.js readValuationMode() always returns market. The server also ignores a requested valuation_mode and stamps valuationMode market with 'league_adjusted_withdrawn: not_canonical'. src/consensus_edge/scoring_fit.py reads neither flag, and consensus_edge itself is OFF in production. src/league_valuation/challenger.py (shadow challenger, RPA-VAL-015) reuses league_intel.scoring_fit read-only, independent of the flags. scripts/backtest_adjusted_board.py calls the same builder offline.
items.evidenceCollected: (1) git grep of origin/main for both flag names in src, server.py, scripts and frontend: only feature_flags.py, gameplan.py (two reads) and a docstring in league_intel/adjustment.py. (2) server.py get_league_adjusted_values docstring and body (lines ~8720-8800): reads the contract, never writes it. (3) Client: dynasty-data.js line ~2312 'const leagueAdjusted = false'; valuation-mode.js 'WITHDRAWN 2026-08-14 - always MARKET'. (4) frontend/app/settings/page.jsx lines ~619-690 still renders a 'Value basis' select with a 'My league' option and says 'This is the only setting that changes the numbers themselves. It applies everywhere - rankings, the trade calculator, exports.' and that My league 'scale[s] every player at that position by up to +/-10%'. That is untrue since the withdrawal. (5) Box, read-only: data/idp_fit_snapshots holds one file, 2026-04-26.json (93,250 bytes, mtime 2026-07-21); git grep finds no code in src, scripts or server.py that reads or writes that directory (only audit docs mention it). (6) docs/valuation/LEAGUE_AWARE_METHODOLOGY_REJECTION.md: Decision C, no trustworthy league-aware canonical method yet, 'not a verdict on league-aware valuation as a product goal'. (7) docs/CHASE_UPSIDE_RUN_LOG.md 2026-07-28: idp_scoring_fit turned ON by operator request, then corrected the same day (DB-highest was wrong; DL-highest is right after the QB-hit alias fix). (8) Issue #803 open since 2026-08-11, zero comments; OWNER_REQUESTED_TODO.md line 412 'P1 valuation methodology ... TODO'; Scope Manifest C5-FIT-01 ABSENT, IMPLEMENT, P6.
items.evaluationCriteria: Pre-existing: docs/adjusted-board-backtest.md and scripts/backtest_adjusted_board.py (the adjusted board is ranked against realized 2025 scoring; four framings returned 'no difference detected'); the reception-fit dispersion bound 0.12 and clamp checks in the flag comments; #822's seven rejection defects. #803 states requirements (stability, shrinkage, out-of-sample validation, level separate from tilt) but no numeric thresholds: NONE_DEFINED.
items.existingResults: Withdrawn-lens decision recorded (Decision C). The measured live overlay effects before withdrawal were +1.8% QB to +9.8% DL (rejection record). The scoring-fit axes never reached rankDerivedValue on the default board. The IDP fit direction was corrected on 2026-07-28 (DL 1.0421, DB 0.9971, LB 0.9608).
